Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Content Migration Specialist position at ACENSI. With my background in digital marketing and content management, I am confident in my ability to migrate and implement content into your client's new CMS, ensuring accuracy and consistency.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage WordPress sites, including content uploads, page updates, and on-page SEO. I have hands-on experience with CMS platforms, and while I have not used Sitecore specifically, I am quick to learn new systems. My attention to detail and organizational skills ensure that content is structured correctly and delivered on time.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available to work on-site in Brussels. I have a good level of Dutch (B1) and English, and I am eager to contribute to a smooth website launch.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your needs. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
